scope: Phase2 independent Skills wiring, generic app upgrade/data recovery and runtime-recipient consent review. Other owners run final frozen builds/regressions and actual ACP fixture integration.

findings.issue: entry_path mutations did not advance persistent generation; quick streaming validation missed changed or restored entry scopes. Package identity restoration also left no scope-generation trace.
findings.change: Add an IF NOT EXISTS scope trigger on real package_id/entry_path changes, advancing the entry generation and old/new package revisions. Existing databases gain it on reopen. No-op and unrelated sibling scope changes preserve the selected lease.
findings.testScope: Real library SQLite plus actual AgentHost streaming with a synthetic runtime; no ACP/provider/network.

findings.issue: A missing persisted upgraded generation was recursively recreated, including after restart or exact-package reinstall; symbolic data roots were not rejected by the host before execution.
findings.change: Persisted data roots must be absolute existing normal directories. Missing paths fail host_app_data_missing; non-directory/symlink roots fail host_app_data_invalid before worker startup. Original data is never replaced by a fresh directory.

findings.issue: Ordinary v1 data paths remained NULL after successful use, so the earlier persisted-only check still permitted empty recreation. Historical NULL uninstall markers could also wash used data back into a fresh reinstall.
findings.change: Only a disabled revision1 NULL legacy install may create its initial directory. Learn the exact existing path using identity/version/revision CAS without advancing authority; used historical NULL rows require existing data. Retain the exact known legacy pointer on uninstall. Upgrade permits only NULL legacy to exact existing non-symlink managed legacy path equivalence; all version/digest/revision/data-version guards remain.
findings.testScope: Seven new cases plus fifteen unchanged upgrade cases. Real independently packaged Echo workers, real v1-to-v2 upgrade, temporary data moved and preserved, restart/reinstall, restoration, historical NULL, and fresh cold-start upgrade.

runtimeConsentAnalysis.knownExplicitCliRuntimeNoneOverride: Assigned to another agent; not claimed fixed or accepted by this review.

remainingBoundaries: Authenticated official Grok account, paid/live behavior, external targets and native desktop GUI are not tested.
Generic upgrades isolate copied data and retain old pointers; they do not roll back external side effects or provide an arbitrary hostile-code OS/network sandbox.
Retained/candidate generation garbage collection, orphan-process recovery, power-loss durability and rollback UI retain the explicit limitations in the upgrade design.
Host recovery checks data directory identity/existence; app owners remain responsible for integrity and missing-file semantics inside their own databases.
This focused review is not final acceptance of all phase2 features, browser behavior, current whole-suite counts or complete legacy engine migration.
sharedSourceEditsAuthorizedByParent: Reject missing persisted generations and learn exact ordinary legacy pointers
